verdict.rationale: Evidence covers Keycloak's REST APIs, OIDC endpoints, admin CLI (kcadm), and protocol standards, but nothing documents official client SDKs/libraries for developers (let alone AI-native/agentic use) — and probes confirm no machine-readable API spec (openapi.json 404) or llms.txt is exposed. Missing for 10: any mention of official SDKs (Java, Node, Python, etc.), agent/AI-specific integration libraries, or programmatic SDK documentation.
